faq.description: What you need to know to choose your package and prepare your project.

items.question: Which package should I choose?
items.answer: Starter is for a single-page website, Standard for a website with up to 4 pages, and Advanced for a bilingual website with up to 6 pages. Compare the scopes in the package cards on this page.

items.question: How do I order?
items.answer: To work with us directly, start by telling us about your project. We prepare a quote setting out the scope, timeline and terms. Work begins once you have accepted the quote, paid the deposit and provided the required materials. You can also order your chosen package on Upwork.

items.question: What do I need to provide before we start?
items.answer: Your text, logo, images, social media links, colours and visual preferences, as well as your legal information where needed.

items.question: Are the domain name and hosting included?
items.answer: Not in the packages. Domain, professional email and external subscription fees remain your responsibility, and the domain stays in your name. For hosting, the website launch option offers two choices: host the website on your own account (the host's subscription then remains your responsibility), or let Megahana host it, with {months} months of hosting included, then a subscription of €{price}/month (indicative price, coming soon). On Upwork, only hosting on your own account is available.

items.question: Is website launch included?
items.answer: No. Your package covers website creation and delivery of the source files. The standard website launch option, priced at {amount} €, covers domain and host configuration, the first deployment and basic checks. Migrating an existing site or a complex setup are out of scope and are quoted separately. Provider fees and ongoing support or maintenance are not included. See the "Optional website launch" section on this page for details.

items.question: Will I receive the source files?
items.answer: Yes. Every package is delivered with the complete website source files.

items.question: How many languages are included?
items.answer: Starter and Standard include one language. Advanced includes a structure for up to 2 languages.

items.question: How do multilingual content and translation work?
items.answer: You provide the text in each language you want. Translation is not included by default: if needed, it is discussed separately or added to the scope.

items.question: Are advanced forms or email marketing included?
items.answer: No. Advanced forms, newsletters, email automations and external integrations are not included and require a separate agreement.

items.question: What are the timelines and revisions?
items.answer: For direct projects, the timeline and number of revisions are confirmed in your quote. The delivery timeline starts once you have accepted the quote, paid the deposit and provided all the required project materials. For Upwork orders, the timeline and revisions are specified in the order on the platform.

items.question: How do direct payments work?
items.answer: You can pay by card via Stripe or by bank transfer. A deposit is requested when you accept the quote. The balance is paid at delivery, after you approve the website and before the source files are handed over and any optional launch takes place. Amounts and payment terms are set out in your quote.

items.question: What counts as one revision?
items.answer: A revision is a batch of feedback you send us grouped together in a single message, not unlimited back-and-forth as you go. Group your requests together before sending them so each revision counts in full.

caseStudy.tagline: A web platform to discover, save, rate and comment on mangas, manhwas and webtoons.
caseStudy.intro: MegaReco was created to centralise the discovery and tracking of works in a modern, clear and accessible interface. The platform lets users explore new works, manage their favourites, track their activity and take part in the community.
caseStudy.role: I designed and developed the whole project solo, from product thinking and interface design to full-stack development, the database, deployment and maintenance.

challenges.title: Authentication and security
challenges.problem: Allow account creation while protecting access and verifying email addresses.
challenges.solution: An authentication system with email verification, password recovery, session management and rate limiting against abuse.
challenges.result: A reliable login experience suited to a production application.

challenges.title: Gamification and progression
challenges.problem: Reward user activity without granting the same rewards multiple times.
challenges.solution: A system of levels, XP, titles and achievements able to automatically check already-met conditions.
challenges.result: Consistent progression that encourages regular use of the platform.

challenges.title: Administration and moderation
challenges.problem: Manage works, suggestions and community content without touching the database directly.
challenges.solution: A dedicated admin interface with validation, editing and moderation tools.
challenges.result: Faster, safer and more autonomous management of the platform.

challenges.title: Responsive and user experience
challenges.problem: Keep clear navigation on desktop and mobile alike.
challenges.solution: Adapting grids, menus, carousels, forms, tables and pagination to different screen sizes.
challenges.result: A consistent experience across desktop, tablet and smartphone.

architecture.deployment: Frontend deployed on Vercel, API hosted on Render and database managed with Neon.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: Privacy policy for the Megahana website: data processed, external services, user rights and cookies.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body:
This policy describes how data may be processed when using the Megahana website.
It applies to the current version of the site, which is a showcase website presenting our services.

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body:
The site is a showcase website and does not offer account creation.
The contact form (Contact page) collects the information you choose to provide: name, email address, subject (optional) and message. This information is sent via Web3Forms, a third-party service that delivers the message to Megahana by email, and is not used for any other purpose.
Technical data (for example IP address, browser type, connection logs) may also be processed automatically by the host or the external services used, in order to ensure the operation and security of the site.

sections.heading: Purposes of processing
External services used
sections.body:
The contact form uses Web3Forms to deliver messages by email; see their privacy policy for details on how they process data.
Commercial exchanges may also take place via Upwork, LinkedIn or email depending on the case — these services have their own privacy policies, which we encourage you to review.
The site is deployed on Vercel or a suitable platform, which may process technical data as the host.

sections.heading: Retention period
sections.body:
Messages sent through the contact form are kept for as long as needed to handle your enquiry, then deleted if they do not lead to a business relationship.
Technical data processed by the host or the external services is retained according to the periods defined by those providers.
Exchanges carried out via Upwork, LinkedIn or email are retained according to those services' own policies and the applicable legal obligations (in particular accounting obligations for invoicing documents).

sections.heading: Data sharing
sections.body:
Megahana does not sell your data.
The only data processed is handled by the technical and commercial providers mentioned above, within the limits necessary to provide their services.

sections.heading: User rights
sections.body:
In accordance with the applicable data protection regulations (in particular the GDPR for European Union residents), you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection and restriction regarding your data.
To exercise these rights, you can contact us at: omerovic.ahmed.work@gmail.com.
Depending on the service concerned (Upwork, LinkedIn, etc.), some requests must be addressed directly to the provider.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any question regarding this privacy policy: omerovic.ahmed.work@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Cookies and trackers
sections.body:
As it stands, the site does not use advertising cookies or audience analytics tools requiring your consent.
Only cookies or trackers strictly necessary for the technical operation of the site may be used.
Should audience measurement or marketing tools (for example Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Hotjar) be added later, a consent management mechanism would be put in place.
